evidence.quote: Probably ask the agent.

evidence.quote: A more sophisticated example might be like, during every sales call, I want it transcribed and any product ideas, I want an agent in the background to build me a prototype of that thing so that by the end of the call, I can demo it to my customer.

entities.name: 转型 (pivot)
entities.how_described: 本集给了一个假设检验框架：只有拿到真实证据、证明假设根基错了、穷尽所有选项才该转；好的转型是被客户「拽出来」的，而不是因为被拒后觉得「那边的草更绿」

evidence.quote: Generally isn't a good way to pivot.

evidence.quote: Those pivots where your customers pull the pivot out of you tend to be easier ones to make the decision about making.
